answer.moreHeading: Why agencies choose MMC as a white-label partner

steps.t: Put your logo on what the client sees.
steps.d: The dashboard, the report and every deliverable carry your name, colours and format. MMC appears only if you choose it.

steps.t: Keep margin, notes and tasks on your side.
steps.d: Internal notes, costs and task lists sit in an agency view that your client never opens.

steps.t: Agree who sees what before work starts.
steps.d: A written split of client-facing and agency-only information means nothing reaches the client by accident.

steps.t: Send the monthly report from your domain.
steps.d: We prepare it, you read it, and it goes out from your address under your logo.
